title: World Gun Ownership
credit: World Population Review, from the Small Arms Survey 2017 Global Firearms Holdings. Civilian guns per 100 people, plus civilian, military and law-enforcement firearm totals. Indonesia and Taiwan have no per-person rate in the source table. One pin for the entire United States. Saved copy, not a live feed.
originalSource: Small Arms Survey 2017, Global Firearms Holdings
note: One pin at each country centroid. The United States is a single country pin, not per state. Figures are a saved snapshot of the World Population Review table (2017), not live.
